description: This script monitors the startup memory usage (RSS) of a Node.js application by executing specific command cases, measuring maximum RSS, and reporting if it exceeds predefined limits. It is designed to be run in CI environments to ensure startup memory bounds are maintained.

methods.name: formatFixGuidance
methods.description: Generates guidance text for fixing startup memory issues based on a test case.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats a detailed failure message including guidance for diagnosis.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Parses the maximum RSS value reported in the stderr output.

methods.name: buildBenchEnv
methods.description: Constructs environment variables for benchmarking, isolating the process environment.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a test case, measures RSS, and throws errors if limits are exceeded.
